name: @projexlight/connector-twilio-voice
summary: Telephony channel connector (P15·E4) for Twilio Voice: provisions tenant tracking numbers, places outbound calls with status-callback + recording + answering-machine detection, and mirrors call/recording state via public Twilio webhooks. Upstream I/O goes through a pluggable provider (setTwilioVoiceProvider), so the package carries no twilio dependency and works unconfigured — a built-in stub returns synthetic SIDs to keep the happy path green without live credentials. Recording is gated at the source on an sdk-consent decision (fail-closed), so no audio is ever captured without an explicit grant, and provision/place/release actions emit sdk-audit events.

endpoints.description: Provision a Twilio tracking number for the tenant (via the pluggable provider) and write the mirror row; 409 if the tenant already holds that number active, 422 on provider failure.
List the tenant's tracking numbers, newest first, optionally filtered by status with limit/offset paging.
Release a tracking number back to Twilio and mark the row 'released' (kept, not deleted, so past calls stay attributable); 404 if unknown.
Place an outbound call with status-callback, consent-gated recording and answering-machine detection requested; resolves caller id from from_number/tracking number, 400 when none is available.
List the tenant's calls, newest first, optionally filtered by status, direction and is_voicemail with limit/offset paging.
Fetch one tenant-scoped call mirror row by id; 404 when it does not exist.

PUBLIC Twilio call-progress callback (X-Twilio-Signature auth, no JWT): advances the call status and classifies voicemail via AnsweredBy; acknowledges an unknown Call SID with 202 so Twilio stops retrying.
PUBLIC Twilio recording-status callback (X-Twilio-Signature auth, no JWT): stores the recording SID/duration and, only on a consent grant, the audio pointer; 202 for an unresolvable Call SID.

models.description: Tenant-pinned Twilio number mirror; UNIQUE(install_id, external_id) and a partial unique index permitting one active claim per (tenant, phone_number). Rows are retained as 'released' rather than deleted.
Outbound/inbound call mirror written in 'queued' and completed by the status/recording webhooks; carries recording_consent, recording_withheld_reason, answered_by and is_voicemail.

scenarios.title: Provision a tenant tracking number
scenarios.when_to_use: When a tenant install needs a Twilio number pinned to it so inbound calls can be attributed to a campaign, source or persona, and outbound calls have a caller id.
scenarios.expected_outcome: The provider claims/mints the number, a connector_twilio_voice.tracking_number row is upserted (idempotent on install_id+external_id), a twilio-voice.number.provisioned.v1 audit event is emitted, and the active TrackingNumberRecord is returned. HTTP callers POST the same fields to /api/voice/tracking-numbers and get 201; a duplicate active number yields 409.

scenarios.title: Place an outbound call with consent-gated recording
scenarios.when_to_use: When placing an outbound call that should be recorded and have answering-machine detection, while never capturing audio unless recording consent has been granted for the destination.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Caller id is resolved (explicit from_number, else the referenced/most-recent active tracking number, else NoCallerIdAvailable). Recording is requested from Twilio only when mayRecord(consent) is true, otherwise recording_withheld_reason records why. The voice_call row is written in 'queued', twilio-voice.call.placed.v1 is emitted, and the record is returned. Via HTTP this is POST /api/voice/calls -> 201.

scenarios.title: Complete a call from the Twilio status webhook and classify voicemail
scenarios.when_to_use: When Twilio posts call-progress callbacks and you need to verify the signature, advance the mirror row, and detect whether the call was answered by a human or a machine (voicemail).
scenarios.expected_outcome: On a verified signature the matching voice_call is advanced to its normalized status and AnsweredBy is mapped so a machine answer sets is_voicemail. An unmatched Call SID returns { matched: false } which the route acknowledges with 202 (not 404) so Twilio stops retrying; a mismatched signature under enforcement yields 401.

compliance_posture.notes: Telephony connector handling PII: phone numbers, call metadata and (optionally) call-recording audio pointers. Call recording is gated at the source on an sdk-consent decision and fails closed — no audio is captured without an explicit grant, and recording_withheld_reason preserves why it was suppressed — addressing two-party-consent / call-recording law and TCPA-style dialing considerations. Webhooks authenticate by X-Twilio-Signature (fail-closed once TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN is set), not tenant JWT. Numbers are released (not deleted) so historical calls stay attributable, and provision/place/release actions emit sdk-audit events; call rows may carry tenant business data in scope for GDPR data-subject requests.

pricing_skus.description: Provision a Twilio tracking number for a tenant install.
Place an outbound call through the Twilio voice connector.
